description: Displays native iOS Action Sheet and Share Sheet components. Provides a way to show a set of options or share content natively on iOS.

showActionSheetWithOptions.signature: static showActionSheetWithOptions(options: ActionSheetIOSOptions, callback: (buttonIndex: number) => void)
showActionSheetWithOptions.description: Displays an iOS action sheet with buttons, title, message, and optional customization.

options.options: array of strings - list of button titles (required)
options.cancelButtonIndex: number - index of cancel button in options
options.cancelButtonTintColor: string - color for cancel button text
options.destructiveButtonIndex: number or array - index/indices of destructive buttons
options.title: string - title displayed above buttons
options.anchor: number - node to which the action sheet is anchored (iPad only)
options.tintColor: string - color for non-destructive button titles
options.disabledButtonIndices: array of numbers - indices of disabled buttons

parameters.callback: function(buttonIndex: number) - called with the index of the pressed button

dismissActionSheet.description: Dismisses the currently presented iOS action sheet. Logs a warning if no action sheet is present.

showShareActionSheetWithOptions.signature: static showShareActionSheetWithOptions(options: ShareActionSheetIOSOptions, failureCallback: (error: Error) => void, successCallback: (success: boolean, method: string) => void)
showShareActionSheetWithOptions.description: Displays the iOS share sheet for sharing messages, URLs, and subjects.

options.subject: string - subject of the message
options.excludedActivityTypes: array - activities to exclude from the share sheet

parameters.successCallback: function(success: boolean, method: string) - called on success, method indicates how content was shared

notes: If url points to a local file or base64 URI, it will be shared directly.
ActionSheetIOS is iOS-only; Android requires a different approach.
Use showActionSheetWithOptions for standard action sheets and showShareActionSheetWithOptions for sharing content.
